cadcraft.name: app_info
cadcraft.title: About this window
cadcraft.description: CadCraft's window: the drawing open, whether it has unsaved changes, the space shown (model or a sheet), whether a command is running, and the permissions the person allowed.

cadcraft.name: drawing_describe
cadcraft.title: Describe the drawing
cadcraft.description: Units and length format, extents, the layer table (state and object counts), blocks and their uses, objects by type, sheets with their viewports, views.

cadcraft.name: objects_list
cadcraft.title: List objects
cadcraft.description: Objects of the drawing, filtered and paged: id, type, layer, colour, geometry (drawing units), length/area where it has one, and a one-line description.

cadcraft.name: object_get
cadcraft.title: Get one object
cadcraft.description: One object in full (every field; a reference with its block definition).

cadcraft.name: drawing_check
cadcraft.title: Check against standards
cadcraft.description: Check the drawing against layer and drafting rules (layers.allowed / required / noObjectsOn, objects.colorByLayer / linetypeByLayer / lineweightByLayer / textHeights / textStyles, blocks.noUnused, units).

cadcraft.name: selection_get
cadcraft.title: Get the selection
cadcraft.description: The objects the person has selected now (ids and one-line descriptions, up to 1000).

cadcraft.name: view_describe
cadcraft.title: Describe the view
cadcraft.description: What is on screen: the space or sheet, the visible area in drawing units, the zoom, split-screen panes, and which layers are visible.

cadcraft.name: view_screenshot
cadcraft.title: Picture of the view
cadcraft.description: A PNG of the drawing as it is on screen (up to 1600 px on the long side).

cadcraft.name: command_run
cadcraft.title: Run a CadCraft command
cadcraft.description: Type at CadCraft's command line: one string, or a list where each item answers the next prompt ("" = Enter); items may also be {pick: [x, y]}, {window: [x1, y1, x2, y2], crossing}, {entity: id} or {escape: true}. Example: ["LINE", "0,0", "@100,0", ""]. A command still waiting at the end is ended with Esc. The whole call is one undo step labelled "Assistant: …"; the person sees it in the command history.

cadcraft.name: selection_set
cadcraft.title: Set the selection
cadcraft.description: Select objects by id (replace, add or remove); the next command acts on them (noun-verb). Unknown ids are refused.

cadcraft.name: undo
cadcraft.title: Undo
cadcraft.description: Undo the assistant's last steps (only steps labelled "Assistant:" unless any is true).

cadcraft.name: drawing_save
cadcraft.title: Save the drawing
cadcraft.description: CadCraft's own Save, in the drawing's format (or the one given): on the desktop it is written to its file; in a browser it is downloaded as a copy.

cadcraft.name: drawing_plot
cadcraft.title: Plot to PDF
cadcraft.description: A vector PDF of a sheet (layout) or of the model (extents or a window, on a paper at a scale or fitted), downloaded (desktop: saved where the person chooses). Papers iso-a4, iso-a3, iso-a2, iso-a1, iso-a0, letter, legal, ansi-b, ansi-c, ansi-d, arch-c, arch-d, arch-e; scales "1:50", "1/4\" = 1'-0\"" or "fit".

takeoffcraft.name: app_info
takeoffcraft.title: About this window
takeoffcraft.description: TakeoffCraft's window: the takeoff open, its PDFs, items and marks, the sheet shown, and the permissions the person allowed.

takeoffcraft.name: sheets_list
takeoffcraft.title: List sheets
takeoffcraft.description: The sheets of the open PDFs, each with its scale (or none) and how many marks it holds.

takeoffcraft.name: items_list
takeoffcraft.title: List items
takeoffcraft.description: The takeoff items: type (linear, area, count), unit, height, waste, material and labor rates, and their assembly components with formulas.

takeoffcraft.name: takeoff_quantities
takeoffcraft.title: Quantities
takeoffcraft.description: Quantities per item (in its unit) or per sheet. Marks on sheets with no scale are listed as unscaled, never counted as zero.

takeoffcraft.name: takeoff_estimate
takeoffcraft.title: Estimate
takeoffcraft.description: The priced estimate as TakeoffCraft computes it: a row per item and per assembly component, totals in cents and as text; incomplete when a formula fails or marks are unscaled.

takeoffcraft.name: takeoff_export
takeoffcraft.title: Export the estimate
takeoffcraft.description: TakeoffCraft's own export of the estimate, as .csv or .xlsx, downloaded (desktop: saved where the person chooses).

markupcraft.name: app_info
markupcraft.title: About this window
markupcraft.description: MarkupCraft's window: the PDF sets open, the sheet shown, how many markups, the reviewer name, and the permissions the person allowed.

markupcraft.name: sheets_list
markupcraft.title: List sheets
markupcraft.description: The sheets of the open PDFs (number from 1, title, file, size in inches) with their markup counts.

markupcraft.name: markups_list
markupcraft.title: List markups
markupcraft.description: Markups (type, sheet, text, comment, measurement, status, author, dates, punch item, replies), filtered by sheet, status, type or author, paged.

markupcraft.name: markup_add
markupcraft.title: Add a markup
markupcraft.description: Add a markup to a sheet as one undo step ("Assistant: add …"): rect, cloudrect, ellipse or text take rect [x0, y0, x1, y1]; note takes at [x, y]; line and arrow take from [x, y] and to [x, y]. Coordinates are fractions of the sheet (0 to 1 from its lower-left corner, as the page is stored, before any rotation) unless units is "pt" (PDF points). text is the words of a text box or note; comment is a note on any markup.

modelcraft.name: app_info
modelcraft.title: About this window
modelcraft.description: ModelCraft's window: the model's display unit, how many groups and components it has, unsaved changes, and the permissions the person allowed.

modelcraft.name: model_describe
modelcraft.title: Describe the model
modelcraft.description: The model: display unit, extents (meters, Z up) and size, loose faces and edges, every group and component placed (id, name, where, whether it is a closed solid, volume in m³), components and scenes.

modelcraft.name: view_screenshot
modelcraft.title: Picture of the view
modelcraft.description: A PNG of the 3D view as shown (up to 1600 px on the long side).

modelcraft.name: box_add
modelcraft.title: Add a box
modelcraft.description: A box as a new group: its lowest corner at `at` [x, y] or [x, y, z] and its size [width (x), depth (y), height (z)]. Numbers are in the model's display unit; text such as "10'", "3.2m" or "600mm" works too. One undo step.

modelcraft.name: cylinder_add
modelcraft.title: Add a cylinder
modelcraft.description: A cylinder as a new group standing on `center` [x, y] or [x, y, z], with a radius and a height (display unit, or text with a unit), 24 sides unless given. One undo step.

modelcraft.name: instance_move
modelcraft.title: Move a group
modelcraft.description: Move a group or component (id from model_describe) by [dx, dy] or [dx, dy, dz]. One undo step.

modelcraft.name: instances_erase
modelcraft.title: Erase groups
modelcraft.description: Erase groups or components placed in the model (ids from model_describe). One undo step.

modelcraft.name: undo
modelcraft.title: Undo
modelcraft.description: Undo the assistant's last steps (only steps labelled "Assistant:" unless any is true).

detailcraft.name: app_info
detailcraft.title: About this window
detailcraft.description: DetailCraft's window: the model open (name, unsaved changes), how many members, connections, footings, stairs, parts, marks and bolts it has, its steel weight, how many problems, and what the person is in the middle of.

detailcraft.name: model_describe
detailcraft.title: Describe the model
detailcraft.description: The open DetailCraft model in millimetres: grids (numbered lines at x, lettered at y), levels (z), phases, members by type and profile, connections by type, footings and stairs.

detailcraft.name: parts_list
detailcraft.title: List part marks
detailcraft.description: The bill of materials by part mark: type, profile, material, cut length (mm), count, weight each and in all (kg, gross), phase, assembly marks and the part ids. Filters: type, profile, mark, phase.

detailcraft.name: problems_list
detailcraft.title: List problems
detailcraft.description: What the Problems tab lists: connections that cannot be built or need a look, holes off their parts, footings without room for their bars, stair checks. Each with the member, connection, footing or stair it is about.

detailcraft.name: clash_check
detailcraft.title: Check clashes
detailcraft.description: The clash check: steel parts and footings that reach into each other by more than the tolerance (mm), leaving out what a connection means to meet. Optionally only some phases.

detailcraft.name: selection_get
detailcraft.title: What is selected
detailcraft.description: What the person has selected in DetailCraft, each described (member: type, profile, mark, ends; connection: type and members; footing; stair).

detailcraft.name: selection_set
detailcraft.title: Select
detailcraft.description: Select members, connections, footings or stairs to show them to the person: by refs ({kind, id}) or by part marks (every member with that mark). Changes nothing in the model.

detailcraft.name: member_add
detailcraft.title: Add a member
detailcraft.description: Add a beam, column, brace or plate between two points (mm). Profile by name (catalog, e.g. W16x26, IPE300, HSS4x4x1/4, or PL20x200 for a plate); position top|middle|bottom puts the reference line on the top of steel, the middle or the bottom; rotation in degrees about its axis. One undo step.

detailcraft.name: connection_add
detailcraft.title: Add connections
detailcraft.description: Connect where the given members meet, as the Connect buttons do: endplate or sheartab (at every free end of the beams that meets a column), baseplate (under each column), splice (where the pieces meet another of their profile end to end), gusset (at every brace end on a column or beam). Default parameters; one undo step. Returns the new connection ids and any problems they report.

detailcraft.name: undo
detailcraft.title: Undo
detailcraft.description: Undo the assistant's last steps (labelled "Assistant: …"); steps the person made are only undone with any: true.

detailcraft.name: model_save
detailcraft.title: Save the model
detailcraft.description: DetailCraft's own Save: the model as .detailcraft.json (desktop: in place; browser: downloaded).

detailcraft.name: model_export
detailcraft.title: Export
detailcraft.description: One of DetailCraft's own exports, downloaded as the Output buttons do: ifc (IFC4), nc (DSTV NC files, zipped), bom (CSV), bending (bending schedule CSV), kiss (KISS file), cutlist (cut list CSV).
